Three.js 0.180.0, vendored from the published npm package via jsDelivr.

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/three.core.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/LICENSE

MIT license retained alongside the unmodified distribution files. Served locally;
visitors do not contact a CDN to load the AR playground.

GLTFLoader.js and BufferGeometryUtils.js are from the same 0.180.0 package,
under examples/jsm/loaders and examples/jsm/utils. Only their import paths
were adjusted to resolve the local distribution above. No API key is used
by any browser-side file.
